SELECT B.ACTIVITY_NO AS activityNo, B.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS title, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, B.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(B.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS enrollDate, B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount,
C.CERTIFICATION_NO AS categoryNo, CC.CERTIFICATION_NAME AS categoryName
FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION C ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = C.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION_CATEGORY CC ON C.CERTIFICATION_NO = CC.CERTIFICATION_NO
ORDER BY B.ACTIVITY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE ACTIVITY_NO = #{activityNo}
UPDATE CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE ACTIVITY_NO = #{activityNo}

SELECT B.ACTIVITY_NO AS activityNo, B.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS title, B.ACTIVITY_CONTENT AS content, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, B.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(B.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS enrollDate, B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount,
C.CERTIFICATION_NO AS categoryNo, CC.CERTIFICATION_NAME AS categoryName,
A.FILE_PATH AS thumbnailPath, A.CHANGE_NAME AS thumbnailName,
B.ADDRESS AS address, B.LAT AS lat, B.LNG AS lng
FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD B JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION C ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = C.ACTIVITY_BOARD_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_CERTIFICATION_CATEGORY CC ON C.CERTIFICATION_NO = CC.CERTIFICATION_NO LEFT JOIN CL_ACTIVITY_ATTACHMENT A ON B.ACTIVITY_NO = A.REF_BNO AND A.THUMBNAIL_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.ACTIVITY_NO = #{id}
